{{Quote|In order to ensure our security and continuing stability, the Republic will be reorganized into the ''first''..Galactic Empire..for a safe and secure...society.|[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Declaration of a New Order]]|audio=Palpatine-Proclamation.flac|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
The following events took place in '''19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was known as '''Year 981''' after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and '''Year 3,634''' after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] came to an end, the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] began, and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Events==
*An [[Battle of Tatooine victory ceremony|awards ceremony]] was conducted by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], honoring the clone troopers [[X1]] and [[X2]] for their actions during the [[Invasion of Tatooine]], immediately preceding the Separatist's attack on Coruscant.<ref name="Elite Squadron DS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' (DS version only)</ref>
*[[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] prototype for integrated [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], was destroyed in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].<ref name="ROTS" />
*Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] mission to rescue [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] proved to be successful, as Skywalker barely managed to crash-land the ''Invisible Hand'' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] surface.<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Delegation of 2000]] [[Petition of 2000|took place]] on Coruscant between the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Republic loyalists]] and Palpatine to determine whether or not he would give up his powers after [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was [[Death/Legends|dead]].
*Palpatine revealed to Skywalker that he was Darth Sidious.<ref name="ROTS" />
*General Grievous was [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|killed]] by Kenobi on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] [[Showdown on Coruscant|attempted]] to arrest Palpatine with Saesee Tiin, Kit Fisto and Agen Kolar after Skywalker informed him that the Chancellor was Darth Sidious, but failed and was killed by Sidious with assistance from the manipulated Skywalker. Skywalker subsequently became Darth Vader, Sidious's third [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] led by Vader [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|raid]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*The [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] began with [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*A [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] squad collected an [[energy crystal]] from [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] towards the end of its [[Battle of Mygeeto|battle]] to power the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]].<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>
*A [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] in the Jedi Temple was altered by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and Kenobi to preserve the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*At the orders of Sidious, Darth Vader [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|massacred]] the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and proceeded to remotely deactivate the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], effectively dissolving the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and ending the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*The Confederacy was reduced to various [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]].
*[[Great ReSynchronization|16:5:23]]<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>&mdash;The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], along with the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], was [[Declaration of a New Order|founded]] by the self-declared [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine, taking the place of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], thus putting [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] directly under the control of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] became the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*The [[Order of the Sith Lords]] took over the galaxy with Sidious as its ruler.<ref name="ROTS" />
*Yoda and Sidious [[Skirmish in the Senate|dueled]] in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*Kenobi and Vader [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|dueled]] on Mustafar; Vader lost and was [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|made]] into a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] Sith apprentice.<ref name="ROTS" />
*Vader constructed his new [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="DL" />
*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] is taken to [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] after being rescued by Kenobi and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. She gives birth to twins [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]] Skywalker. Soon after, she dies from medical complications.<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after her death on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], former [[Junior Representative/Legends|acting]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]], succeeded Amidala as the representative of Naboo's [[Chommell sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="The Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
*Onboard the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] ordered [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] memory to be erased by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] in order to make the locations of the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker twins]] a secret.<ref name="ROTS" />
*The first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] construction was moved from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to [[Despayre]].<ref name="SWE">{{CSWECite|I|186|Despayre}}</ref>
*Yoda's self exile to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] via his [[E3-standard starship lifeboat/Legends|escape pod]], and Kenobi's self exile to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*The [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] adopted [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Skywalker]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] adopted [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on Tatooine.<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Conclave on Kessel|Jedi conclave]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]<ref name="SWP">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref>
*The [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].<ref name="EGTW:AC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>
*The [[Emperor's Citadel]] was constructed on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] for Palpatine to [[Cloning/Legends|cheat death]].
*[[Kota's Militia]] was exiled from their original headquarters.<ref name="TFU DB">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed video game databank|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game databank]]</ref>
*Kenobi found [[Ferus Olin]], the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] and foiled an Imperial plot to mass murder the residents of Bellassa's capital [[City/Legends|city]], [[Ussa]].
*Olin found [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Garen Muln]] in the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="LotJ: DW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>
*Kenobi stopped [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Sancor]] from discovering information about Amidala's death on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] Polis Massa.<ref name="LotJ: DW" />
*Olin and [[Trever Flume]] found Jedi Master [[Fy-Tor-Ana]], now going by the name of Solace, in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]] of Coruscant, with the help of [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]].
*Olin was captured by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the Jedi Temple and then interrogated by Inquisitor [[Malorum]].
*Olin, with the help of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] and [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], defeated Malorum and temporarily rid Naboo of its Imperial presence.
*Olin helped Palpatine against his will on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Samaria/Legends|Samaria]].
*[[Roan Lands]] and [[Dona Telamark]] were rescued by Solace, [[Oryon]], and Flume.
*[[Sir/Legends|Sir]] [[Nevil Tritum]] recovered [[King/Legends|King]] [[Adas]]'s [[Holocron of King Adas|holocron]] from the library of [[House Pelagia]].<ref name="end">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref><ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
